# Campaign component fixtures

`roll-results.html` reproduces the calculation and result structure used by the
saved campaign's dice component, with sample text. No saved scripts are executed.
The full downloaded page and artwork remain under the ignored `references/`
directory and are excluded from both distribution and Forge ZIP packages.

The tiny WebP fixtures are generated test pictures: a transparent 2×2 image and
a solid 4001×4001 image just above the supported pixel limit.

`translation-page.html` and `translation-cases.json` contain handwritten sample RPG/UI text. They exercise reversible translation, Russian/name/URL/dice preservation, editable drafts, streaming content, and local-model quality without account or campaign data.
